story.text: 여행의 마지막 밤, 숙소 마루에 나란히 앉아 휴대폰 사진첩을 넘겨 보았습니다.
story.reading: yeo-haeng-ui ma-ji-mak bam, suk-so ma-ru-e na-ran-hi anj-a hyu-dae-pon sa-jin-cheob-eul neom-gyeo bo-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: On the last night of the trip, we sat side by side on the porch of our lodging, scrolling through the photo album on our phones.

story.text: 공산성, 산성시장, 노래방까지, 사진 한 장 한 장에 지난 며칠의 '추억'이 고스란히 담겨 있었습니다.
story.reading: gong-san-seong, san-seong-si-jang, no-rae-bang-kka-ji, sa-jin han jang han jang-e ji-nan myeo-chil-ui 'chu-eok'-i go-seu-ran-hi dam-gyeo it-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: From Gongsanseong to Sanseong Market to the karaoke room, every single photo held the 'memories' of the past few days, just as they were.

story.text: "이번 여행, 진짜 '잊지 못할' 것 같아." 친구의 나지막한 말에 저도 조용히 고개를 끄덕였습니다.
story.reading: "i-beon yeo-haeng, jin-jja 'it-ji mot-hal' geot gat-a." chin-gu-ui na-ji-mak-han mal-e jeo-do jo-yong-hi go-gae-reul kkeu-deog-yeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "I think this trip is one I'll really 'never forget'." At my friend's quiet words, I nodded silently too.

story.text: 화면 속 웃고 있는 우리 모습이 새삼 낯설면서도 반가웠습니다. 평소엔 잘 안 웃는 얼굴인데 말입니다.
story.reading: hwa-myeon sok ut-go it-neun u-ri mo-seub-i sae-sam nat-seol-myeon-seo-do ban-ga-wot-seum-ni-da. pyeong-so-en jal an ut-neun eol-gul-in-de mal-im-ni-da.
story.en: The sight of us laughing on screen felt strangely unfamiliar yet welcome. It's not a face that usually smiles much, after all.

story.text: 노래방에서 목이 쉬도록 부르던 사진을 보다가, 어쩐지 마음이 '뭉클해졌습니다.'
story.reading: no-rae-bang-e-seo mog-i swi-do-rok bu-reu-deon sa-jin-eul bo-da-ga, eo-jjeon-ji ma-eum-i 'mung-keul-hae-jyeot-seum-ni-da.'
story.en: Looking at a photo of us singing our voices hoarse at karaoke, I somehow felt my heart 'grow full and moved.'

story.text: "이 '순간'을 사진으로 남겨 둬서 다행입니다." 저는 화면을 손끝으로 가만히 쓸어 보았습니다.
story.reading: "i 'sun-gan'-eul sa-jin-eu-ro nam-gyeo dwo-seo da-haeng-im-ni-da." jeo-neun hwa-myeon-eul son-kkeut-eu-ro ga-man-hi sseul-eo bo-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "I'm glad we captured this 'moment' in a photo." I gently traced the screen with my fingertip.

story.text: 바쁜 일상 속에서도 이렇게 만든 시간이 얼마나 '소중한지', 새삼 깨달았습니다.
story.reading: ba-ppeun il-sang sog-e-seo-do i-reo-ke man-deun si-gan-i eol-ma-na 'so-jung-han-ji', sae-sam kkae-dal-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: In the middle of a busy daily life, I realized once again just how 'precious' the time we'd carved out like this was.

story.text: 사진첩을 다 넘길 때쯤, 창밖은 이미 캄캄해져 있었습니다. 그날 밤 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: sa-jin-cheob-eul da neom-gil ttae-jjeum, chang-bakk-eun i-mi kam-kam-hae-jyeo it-eot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal bam na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: By the time we finished scrolling through the album, it was already pitch dark outside. Let me share the conversation we had that night.

words.example_en: I made a lot of good memories on the trip.
I can't forget the scenery from that day.
Reading the letter, my heart felt full.
Time with family is always precious.

sentences.ko: 이 여행은 평생 잊지 못할 추억이 되었습니다.
sentences.reading: i yeo-haeng-eun pyeong-saeng it-ji mot-hal chu-eog-i doe-eot-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: This trip became a memory I'll never forget for the rest of my life.

sentences.ko: 그 순간을 절대 잊지 못할 것 같습니다.
sentences.reading: geu sun-gan-eul jeol-dae it-ji mot-hal geot gat-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: I don't think I'll ever be able to forget that moment.
Looking at the old photos, my heart felt full.
I was glad to share that moment together.
The time spent with my friend is truly precious.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 사진 보니까 그때 생각난다. 공산성에서 처음 만났을 때.
turns.reading: sa-jin bo-ni-kka geu-ttae saeng-gang-na-n-da. gong-san-seong-e-seo cheo-eum man-nass-eul ttae.
turns.en: Looking at this photo reminds me of that time — when we first met at Gongsanseong.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 그 순간, 저에게도 정말 특별한 추억입니다.
turns.reading: geu sun-gan, jeo-e-ge-do jeong-mal teuk-byeol-han chu-eog-im-ni-da.
turns.en: That moment is a truly special memory for me too.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 이번 여행 전체가 다 잊지 못할 것 같아.
turns.reading: i-beon yeo-haeng jeon-che-ga da it-ji mot-hal geot gat-a.
turns.en: I think this whole trip is going to be unforgettable.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: I feel the same. I'll remember it for a long time.

dialogues.question: 두 사람이 사진을 보며 가장 먼저 떠올린 기억은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What memory did the two of them first recall while looking at the photos?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 사진을 보며 공산성에서 처음 만났던 순간을 가장 먼저 떠올렸습니다.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: This photo — it's us singing our hearts out at karaoke.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 맞아, 그때 진짜 웃겼는데. 보기만 해도 뭉클하다.
turns.reading: maj-a, geu-ttae jin-jja ut-gyeon-neun-de. bo-gi-man hae-do mung-keul-ha-da.
turns.en: Right, that was so funny back then. Just looking at it makes me feel moved.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 이런 순간들이 모여서 이번 여행을 만든 것 같습니다.
turns.reading: i-reon sun-gan-deul-i mo-yeo-seo i-beon yeo-haeng-eul man-deun geot gat-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: It seems like moments like these are what made this trip what it was.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그러니까 더 소중하지. 이 사진들, 잘 간직하자.
turns.reading: geu-reo-ni-kka deo so-jung-ha-ji. i sa-jin-deul, jal gan-jik-ha-ja.
turns.en: That's exactly why it's so precious. Let's take good care of these photos.

dialogues.question: 승객은 사진첩을 보며 어떤 감정을 느꼈나요?
dialogues.question_en: What emotion did the passenger feel while looking through the photo album?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 사진을 보며 뭉클함을 느꼈고, 그 순간들이 소중하다고 말했습니다.
